scope: Six supplied rollout files only. Not a complete WMP project total. Original development session spans two files; selected older child sessions and speedup thread are excluded. Main audit-resume file of 2026-09-29 is excluded.

method.tokens: Sum payload.usage only from token_usage_record, globally deduplicated by response_id. Never sum cumulative token_count or thread_token_usage values. No currency, billed-token or model-work-hour inference.
method.cache: cached_input_tokens is a subset of input_tokens; reasoning_output_tokens is a subset of output_tokens. total=input+output. uncached_input=input-cached_input.
method.tools: Outer call records are deduplicated by thread_id + call_id; nested_tool_request_sites counts literal tools.NAME call sites, not asserted browser clicks or successful calls. Coordination terminal outcomes linked through functions.wait cell IDs where available.
method.time: UTC event timestamps and wall-clock spans only. Contains idle gaps and concurrent work; do not add spans or call them labor time.
method.unmeasured: No consistent per-case retry attempt ID, first-result/per-batch timing log, paired baseline, or complete all-child usage. Cannot estimate percent waste or speedup.
